title: The Night of Returning
prompt: The same kind of hillside town street at night during a once-a-year procession: strings of paper lanterns, a painted theatre cart with a curtain and a crescent-and-pomegranate emblem, banners with symbolic glyphs (no real letters), a cleared wide road for the procession, torches and candles, a deep dusky-blue sky.
palette: Night, dusky blue and plum, warm lantern gold and a few violet lights.
story: Shadow's obsession: a procession about the descent and return. Greek-mystery symbolism in the glyphs, never explained.
